subject: Clarifying Vendr->Archer onboarding scope and SOC2 evidence mapping
messages:
From: Ellie Ramos <ellie@bluecrest-analytics.com>
To: markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@bluecrest-analytics.com, security@bluecrest-analytics.com
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr/Archer onboarding: where to upload SOC2 artifacts?

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the onboarding kickoff yesterday. We're starting to stage our evidence for the two portals (Vendr + Archer) and ran into a couple of scope questions I hoped you could clarify:

- Do you want Bluecrest to upload SOC 2 artifacts (system config screenshots, SOC2 report PDFs) to both portals, or should we place canonical copies in Vendr and only references in Archer?
- SIG/CAIQ mapping: some controls overlap but our security team prefers a single canonical artifact per control with crosswalk metadata. Does Redwood prefer a single-bucket approach or per-portal uploads?

I've attached a rough matrix (vendr_archer_scope_matrix.xlsx) showing our suggested mapping and a short list of items we think will require >30 days to gather (log retention exports, KMS rotation proof).

Can we hop on a 30-minute sync to confirm approach and naming conventions? Available tomorrow morning (Tue) PST.

Thanks,
Ellie Ramos
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Bluecrest Analytics

Attachments:
- vendr_archer_scope_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
To: Ellie Ramos <ellie@bluecrest-analytics.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr/Archer onboarding: where to upload SOC2 artifacts?

Hi Ellie — great matrix, thanks for pulling that together. Quick notes from our side: 

1) Canonical evidence strategy: Redwood prefers a single canonical artifact per control to avoid drift. For portal visibility we ask that you upload the canonical copy to Vendr and place a short metadata reference (Drive link + filename + checksum) in Archer. That keeps the authoritative copy in one place while satisfying both portals.

2) Exceptions: Encrypted audit logs and KMS-backed key rotation proof should have per-portal proof if your contract requires separate custody records. If any item must be duplicated, flag it in column D of your matrix (we can mark it as "duplicate required").

3) Naming conventions: please follow the attached guidance doc we use internally (I'll attach a short text file examples). Use: <company>_<portal>_<control>_<YYYYMMDD>_<version>. Example: bluecrest_vendr_SC-08_20260731_v1.pdf

Mina (CC) — can you confirm the S3 signed URL approach and any minimum TTL we'd want for evidence artifacts? Ben / Jordan — looping you for timeline and any procurement notes (DocuSign/HubSpot links).

I'll block 30m tomorrow at 10:00 PST; Ellie, if that doesn't work send a Calendly.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Trust Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- evidence-naming-guidelines.txt (text)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellie Ramos <ellie@bluecrest-analytics.com>, markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 14:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr/Archer onboarding: where to upload SOC2 artifacts?

Thanks — quick technical guidance from security: 

- S3 signed URLs: we prefer pre-signed PUT URLs with a 7-day TTL for upload and a separate read-only pre-signed GET with 30-day TTL for verification by portal reviewers. After verification please update the metadata in Archer with the verified checksum and a REDACTED flag if necessary.

- KMS evidence: provide the KMS key alias and a signed statement (simple PKCS7 signature or internal CA signature) that the key was rotated on X date. If you can supply a CloudTrail export for the rotation event (CSV) that typically short-circuits review.

- CAIQ/SIG crosswalk: attach a small JSON mapping (one row per control) in your matrix -- we use the mapping to auto-populate portal responses. Example: SC-08 -> CAIQ:SC-1; SIG:A.1.2. If you can't produce JSON, a CSV is fine.

We can accept a single canonical bucket (Vendr) with the extra Archer metadata, but do not put full production logs in Archer (redaction and PII concerns).

If Bluecrest needs, our security engineer can review the first 10 artifacts post-upload to confirm naming/checksums.

-Mina Haddad
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment references:
- s3-signed-url-instructions.pdf (pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellie Ramos <ellie@bluecrest-analytics.com>, markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com, jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr/Archer onboarding: where to upload SOC2 artifacts?

Hi Ellie — quick commercial notes:

- Timeline: for the Dedicated onboarding path we usually expect a 4-week evidence window once artifacts start landing. If you flag any item that will take >30 days, mark it in the matrix and we can set an interim acceptance milestone so procurement isn't blocked.

- DocuSign: procurement asked for the signed SOW before we kickoff bulk uploads. If you can push the countersigned DocuSign, Jordan will attach it to the HubSpot deal so we can track delivery SLAs.

Happy to join the sync if needed.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Ellie Ramos <ellie@bluecrest-analytics.com>

Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr/Archer onboarding: where to upload SOC2 artifacts?

Thanks all — action items and next steps: 

- Bluecrest will:
  * Upload canonical evidence to Vendr bucket this week (first batch by Fri 08/06).
  * Add Archer metadata rows pointing to Vendr artifacts (Drive links + checksums).
  * Produce a small CSV crosswalk (control_id, vendr_file, archer_reference) and attach to the Drive folder.
  * Provide CloudTrail extract and KMS rotation statement for the items flagged in column G of the matrix.

- We will send the countersigned SOW via DocuSign by EOD today (link included in HubSpot deal).

We accept the 10-artifact validation offer from Mina — please confirm who on Bluecrest should send the upload tests (I will send credentials to the pre-signed URL flow).

Proposed time for the short sync: Fri 08/06 at 10:00 PST. Sending Calendly in a follow-up.

Appreciate the clear guidance — will update the matrix and push attachments.

Best,
Ellie
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Bluecrest Analytics
